razonamiento: The visual diagram illustrates an architecture for deploying and running a petrotechnical desktop application (IHS Markit Kingdom) via Amazon AppStream 2.0. Users (students/end users) stream the application from AppStream, which communicates with an EC2-hosted license server, Amazon FSx for file storage, and Amazon RDS (SQL Express) for project data. The deployment lifecycle is automated via AWS CloudFormation, which provisions AppStream, FSx, RDS, and triggers a Lambda custom resource that uses AWS Systems Manager (SSM) to configure the license server EC2 instance. Upon completion, EC2 signals back to CloudFormation via a WaitCondition.
nombre: Delivering Desktop Engineering Software via Amazon AppStream 2.0 and CloudFormation
